summary: Single-instance guard. Calls StringSplitLoop(2, build-version string, 420) and, when it returns nonzero, writes a debug log line announcing OS-manager entry. Then assigns global hObject = CreateMutexA(0, 1, Name) to create a named mutex with initial ownership requested. Returns TRUE when the mutex already exists (GetLastError() == 183, another instance running) or when the handle is null (creation failed); returns FALSE only when this instance created and owns the mutex.

operations.description: Call StringSplitLoop(2, aDDevF119992002_19, 420) to parse the build-version string; the boolean outcome is used only as a log trigger.
When StringSplitLoop returns nonzero, proceed to write the OS-manager entry log line.
Call DebugLogWrite(&dword_8AD25C, aEnteredOsmanEn) to log that the OS manager was entered.
Assign global hObject = CreateMutexA(0, 1, Name): create a named mutex from global Name with initial ownership requested.
Build the return condition: handle null (creation failed) OR GetLastError() == 183 (ERROR_ALREADY_EXISTS, another instance owns the mutex).
Return TRUE when the mutex could not be exclusively created (already running or failure); FALSE when this instance is the sole owner.
